# `company.batch_effects`

What each batch touched, written in the same transaction as the write and its audit event. Immutable.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `batch_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | batches.id | The batch. |
| `seq` | INTEGER | no | — | primary key 2 | — | — | Position within the batch, from 1, in the order written. |
| `record_type` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | ix_batch_effects_record | — | Record type touched (customer, item...). |
| `record_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_batch_effects_record | — | Record touched. |
| `action` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | created, updated, linked, rule_learned; reversed for a reversal batch. |
| `version_after` | INTEGER | yes | — | — | — | — | The record's version the write left; null when it has none. |
| `before` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | JSON of the prior values an update replaced (input-shaped); null otherwise. |
| `event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event of the write. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time the effect was recorded. |
